description: Bump metadata.json's version and prepend a matching RPM-style CHANGELOG entry — only when the repo's working tree is dirty (i.e. an earlier stage changed something worth releasing). Skips (without bumping) repos with no CHANGELOG or a non-X.Y.Z version.

changelog_message.description: CHANGELOG entry body (lines are '- '-prefixed unless they already start with '-' or whitespace)
